allow: PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 12344 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName | Format-List; Stop-Process -Id 12344 -Force -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $left = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name like 'python%'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'data_gather' }; if \($left\) { $left | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; $still = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name like 'python%'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'data_gather' }; if \($still\) { "STILL RUNNING: " + \($still.ProcessId -join ','\) } else { "all collector processes stopped" })
